description: Import a .pptx or .pdf file (PowerPoint, or the PPTX export of Google Slides / Canva / Keynote; a PDF deck) as a fully editable Lorem deck — every text run, color, image, table, chart and note mapped onto the native document model. Also extracts the file's visual style as a reusable Style (see list_styles), first-class next to the curated ones. Anything the model can't express is listed in the fidelity report. After importing, iterate with read_deck / replace_slide / apply_deck as with any deck. `path` only works with the local `lorem-mcp` server — over a remote MCP connection, upload the file in the app (Library → Import) or with POST /api/import instead.

name.description: Deck title override (defaults to the file's)

path.description: Absolute path to the .pptx file on this machine

name: import_deck
title: Import a deck file
